action.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS vendor_count FROM (SELECT vendor_id FROM (SELECT vendor_id, strftime(bill_date, '%Y-%m') AS m, SUM(amount) AS total FROM ap_bills WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND bill_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND bill_date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY vendor_id, m HAVING SUM(amount) > 3000) x GROUP BY vendor_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m) = 6) y
